reuse.why: Extends the two existing holiday consumers (getHolidayExrules and getDateWithSkippedWeekend) and uses monthUtils.parseDate/dayFromDate, though it adds no shared parser for the new MM-DD form.

duplication.why: The MM-DD convention is recognised in two independent ways (a regex plus slicing in getHolidayExrules, a slice(5) set lookup in getDateWithSkippedWeekend) instead of one shared holiday-matching definition.

placement.why: Both edits stay in shared/schedules.ts where holiday handling already lives.

scope.why: Only the two holiday functions and focused tests are changed.

maintainability.why: Readable and small, but the format knowledge is split across two functions and the yearly exrule start derived from config.start.slice(0, 4) is implicit.

disguised_duplication.where: the two MM-DD checks serve different consumers (rschedule exrule vs day-string set) and are visible, not a disguised copy
